title: Boxz Web Code Corpus
licence: MIT (three.js, jQuery) - licence verified via the GitHub API at fetch time
notes: Bounded slice of public MIT-licensed web-game code: three.js examples/*.html (Three.js, WebGL, shaders, animation, games) and jquery/src/*.js (idiomatic browser JavaScript). Fetched by python -m boxz.data.code_corpus, which verifies each project's licence through api.github.com before downloading and records the exact commit SHA per file in data/raw/code_corpus/manifest.json. Files are cleaned of vendored CDN includes; only the project's own markup and code is kept. Not committed to git (large); the fetcher and manifest are.
allowed_use: MIT licensed source code; excerpts redistributed for model training with attribution retained in the manifest.
